verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented overage fee schedule or per-unit rates for exceeding plan limits on bandwidth, invocations or build minutes. The only pricing-adjacent item is a testimonial praising hard spending limits. That is a related cost control, not a published overage rate schedule, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
